card.name: Patient-count denominators in adverse event rates
card.fires_on: The space or first digit of the total patient count right after "n (x%) of the" or "(n/". It fires when the number of patients in the group is about to be given.

modes.label: Space before total
modes.description: The space after "of" or "of the" just before the group size in a count with a percentage.
modes.example: Grade 3-4 diarrhea occurred in 697 (16%) of the<< >>4257 patients who received GI

modes.label: First digit of total
modes.description: The first digit of the denominator, either after a slash in a fraction or after "of".

card.writes: It seems to steer the next token toward a number digit rather than a word, though the listed tokens are mostly unrelated.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a safety statistic where the total number of patients is about to be written, as in "9 (0.3%) of 3291 patients".
